mechanism_assessments.relation_to_cluster_A: The audit directly exercised SHA-only freshness, exact-ref binding, authorized immutable artifact creation, blob-SHA-guarded role-local update, and exact post-write readback. Those operations instantiate the stable-identity/preconditioned-mutation/readback/CAS substrate already represented by Cluster A, especially the open_source direct GitHub transaction recipe. The contribution is stronger execution evidence for a subset of that recipe, not a distinct mechanism family.
mechanism_assessments.discriminating_evidence: Unlike the earlier recipe/documentation synthesis, this role reports direct execution and readback of the repository freshness/persistence/CAS-positive path in ordinary Chat tooling under frozen Phase-1 control.
mechanism_assessments.tested_scope: One reproducibility_auditor repository workflow. Branch and PR creation were schema-visible but intentionally not executed; stale-SHA rejection was not deliberately stress-tested; no protected integration or primary-O mutation was executed.
mechanism_assessments.uncertainty: Does not establish parity for all active roles, branch/PR mutation success, multi-file atomicity, arbitrary external effects, or provider-independent exactly-once semantics.

mechanism_assessments.relation_to_cluster_A: Shares stable-identity/fail-closed principles with Cluster A but protects a different boundary: proof-matrix assignment identity rather than repository mutation authority. It is therefore not an exact duplicate of the authority-safe-commit cluster.
mechanism_assessments.discriminating_evidence: Exact frozen-file comparison found 7 of 7 downstream/optimizer task-id strings differ between O_CHAT_PARALLEL.assignment_matrix and authoritative DOWNSTREAM_STATE assignments. The control itself says downstream assignments resolve through DOWNSTREAM_STATE, so fuzzy aliasing is unsafe under exact-identity joins.
mechanism_assessments.tested_scope: Seven downstream/optimizer roles under the frozen root16/downstream25 tuple. This finding proves deterministic configuration mismatch only; it does not prove any current integrator consumer actually joins against the wrong field.
mechanism_assessments.uncertainty: Impact remains conditional until a post-overlay integrator proof-matrix artifact shows which assignment-id authority is used. If the integrator uses exact DOWNSTREAM_STATE ids, this may remain a documentation/alias hazard rather than an observed false-missing cell.

dedup_delta.main_conclusion: The reproducibility-auditor result does not justify a new repository-transaction mechanism cluster: it directly validates a bounded subset of Cluster A. Separately, the 7/7 exact assignment-id mismatch is genuinely new discriminating evidence because it targets proof identity/join correctness, not commit authority. Keep it separate until the integrator's actual join behavior is observed.

phase1_implications: Ordinary Chat repository freshness/persistence/CAS-positive/readback feasibility now has direct role-local execution evidence, reducing uncertainty around the basic Cluster-A transaction substrate.

This is still not a Phase-1 acceptance pass because branch/PR paths, stale-conflict rejection, multi-role parity, recovery timing, duplication metrics and other acceptance cells remain outside this audit's tested scope.

The assignment-id mismatch can create a fail-closed false-missing proof cell if a consumer joins against O_CHAT_PARALLEL task ids rather than authoritative DOWNSTREAM_STATE ids; the next useful observation is the integrator's actual post-overlay join authority.
No adoption/promotion signal is emitted because the Phase-1 acceptance matrix has not been shown to pass.
explicit_non_evidence: Schema visibility for branch/PR tools is not execution evidence.
A successful CAS-positive update is not evidence of stale-CAS rejection under induced conflict.
One role's repository transaction feasibility is not evidence of all-role Chat parity.
The 7/7 task-id mismatch is not evidence that the integrator currently misjoins receipts.
No protected O/main mutation was performed or inferred.
